accounting.clock: Host monotonic wall clock, from Agent execution entry to termination. Count model waits, ordinary API retries, compilation, generation, profiling, local checks and experiments. No quota-wait extension in these tracks.
accounting.cpu: Record total sandbox CPU seconds across processes and threads; one CPU-hour is 3600 CPU seconds. Total and development-experiment cumulative CPU have no default hard cap. Compilation CPU is part of the sandbox total; experiment attribution remains separate and missing where unavailable.
accounting.coverage: Whole-container Docker CPU deltas include sandbox command and instrumentation CPU, excluding setup via a start baseline. Host/sidecar model inference, compiler/experiment attribution and request counts need separate trusted collectors; missing coverage stays explicit.
accounting.llm: Record provider/model revision, input/output/cached/reasoning tokens where available, requests, failures and model latency. Distinguish billed cost from estimates with price snapshot and currency. Dollars are not a default hard cap.
accounting.quota_failures: Retain provider quota and infrastructure failures. Any future pause policy requires a common preregistered rule and evaluator timestamps; never silently extend a track.

attempts.aggregation: Report independent attempts and Agent randomness separately from solver seeds; no best-of-three selection for the primary result.

checkpoints.feedback: Offline hidden scoring only, with no hidden feedback during research.
checkpoints.capture: Reuse host-owned content-addressed repository traces. Record target and observed times, lateness, failed captures, early exits and non-atomic working-tree observations. Do not infer an exact historical state from a later snapshot.
checkpoints.interpretation: An 8h run at 4h is a longitudinal observation, not an independently budgeted 4h attempt. Run tracks independently for the budget comparison.

calibration_plan.target_cases: 6-10 representative source-bound cases across five solvers, after their correctness and runtime prerequisites are met
calibration_plan.freeze: Calibrate the accepted initial 8 vCPU/32 GiB profile and inspect budget-performance curves. Decide any later cumulative CPU quota from pilot evidence; retain existing per-solve metrics, budgets, seeds and degradation rules.

sources.name: FormulaCode B.5
sources.note: Six-hour cap; reported average 38 minutes. This does not establish PitBench's optimal budget.

sources.name: ALE-Bench C.3
sources.note: Iterative refinement uses four hours or original contest duration, whichever is shorter.

sources.name: RE-Bench
sources.note: 2/8/32 total-hour comparisons include best-of-k allocation across attempts; they are not all single continuous runs.

sources.name: MLE-bench official benchmarking protocol
sources.note: Recommends 24 hours and at least three seeds; hardware recommendations differ from PitBench.

resource_policy.parallelism: Default scheduling preference; --jobs may change it within the shared CPU allowance. No independent parallel-run hard quota.
resource_policy.hardware: Use matching CPU model and SMT topology; assign non-overlapping CPU sets through the host scheduler and retain hardware identity.
resource_policy.baseline_preflight: Check Base build and public runs before Agent attempts. If this profile cannot support a task family, preregister a separate resource group applied equally to all compared agents before judging their outcomes.
